notes.title: Der Geisterjäger Scheduled for Release in 2021
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33855917/40a16e3417e1ce49aa539c5068d61f44a265d83d.png[/img]

We'd like to announce Der Geisterjäger, out latest game and our most mechanically complex title to date that will give the fans of tactical turn-based dungeon crawling another scenario filled with brutal labyrinth warfare.

We'll go into deeper detail about new features in the coming weeks.

Wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1581240/Der_Geisterjger__The_Ghost_Hunter/

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 Released
notes.notes:
Changelog:
[list]
[*]Added a quick fade out effect upon dying and leaving the level.
[*]Added 2 new music tracks to the game ('Disoriented' and 'Lost').
[*]Increased the amount of time added by scrolls from 10 to 15 seconds.
[*]Improved campaign generation to avoid duplicates.
[*]Improved music transitions.
[*]Replaced in-game music with better arrangements of the original tracks.
[*]Improved music looping.
[/list]
